cover_contexts: A field guide describing the shape of a maple leaf:
A kitchen note on arranging clean cups on a shelf:
A station bulletin about maintaining a platform clock:
A garden journal describing rain beside a clay pot:

framing.filler: one midpoint bit 1 followed by infinite zeros after envelope
framing.frequency_rule: 1+floor(p*(65536-16)); largest remainder, ties by candidate index
framing.termination: first token whose stable prefix reaches 8*envelope_bytes; emitted excess must match midpoint suffix; canonical midpoint replay; no appended tokens
framing.zero_width: prevented by positive frequencies and E3; reject if encountered

inference.cache: reset and kv_cache_clear per sequence; serial prefill/eval

public_size_class.agreement: pre-agreed public channel setting; no transmitted metadata; bound by HPKE profile

selection.admissibility: strict UTF-8 of full detokenized proposed carrier prefix AND exact retokenization to proposed IDs
selection.candidate_selection: first 16 admissible among first 128 ranked IDs; stop scan once 16 found; no expansion or retry
selection.mapping: integer arithmetic; probability weighted among the same ordered sixteen candidates
selection.numerical_assumption: identical conditional candidate order across cleared-cache processes
selection.order: descending native logits, ascending token ID for exact ties

serialization: raw HPKE envelope bits; finite arithmetic coding on public size class; midpoint extension

tokens.boundary: separate public context; canonical full carrier prefix at each emission
tokens.normalization: none; strict UTF-8; no strip or inserted space
tokens.rank_order: descending native logits; ascending token ID for exact ties
tokens.stop: first token whose stable prefix reaches 8*envelope_bytes; emitted excess must match midpoint suffix; canonical midpoint replay; no appended tokens
tokens.vocabulary: public rank16 admissible alphabet within top 128; attribute mask 27
